zh.title: 航空短訊彙整：捷克研議向烏克蘭供應最多16架L-39 Skyfox；阿聯酋航空將取得六架空中巴士A380-800
zh.summary: 本期收錄4則獨立消息：捷克研議向烏克蘭供應最多16架L-39 Skyfox、阿聯酋航空將取得六架空中巴士A380-800、聯合航空宣佈限制未授權第三方 AI 代理存取訂位平臺。
body: 本期彙整4則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。

1. 捷克研議向烏克蘭供應最多16架L-39 Skyfox
捷克研議向烏克蘭供應最多16架L-39 Skyfox，追加12架僅獲初步確認。

2. 阿聯酋航空將取得六架空中巴士A380-800
阿聯酋航空將取得六架空中巴士A380-800；其中兩架已完成出售

3. 聯合航空宣佈限制未授權第三方 AI 代理存取訂位平臺
聯合航空宣佈限制未授權第三方 AI 代理存取訂位平臺，並將更新運輸條款。

4. Magnifica Air訂購10架空中巴士A220-300 ACJ飛機
Magnifica Air訂購10架A220 ACJ，未來機隊將增至17架。

en.title: Aviation briefs: Czechia weighs supplying Ukraine with up to 16 L-39 Skyfox jets; Emirates to Take Ownership of Six Airbus A380-800s
en.summary: 4 independent updates: Czechia weighs supplying Ukraine with up to 16 L-39 Skyfox jets; Emirates to Take Ownership of Six Airbus A380-800s; United Airlines Restricts Booking-Platform Access for Unauthorized Third-Party AI Agents.
body:
1. Czechia weighs supplying Ukraine with up to 16 L-39 Skyfox jets
Czechia considers supplying Ukraine up to 16 L-39 Skyfox jets; talks on 12 additional jets yielded preliminary confirmation.

2. Emirates to Take Ownership of Six Airbus A380-800s
Emirates will take ownership of six Airbus A380-800s; two sales are complete.

3. United Airlines Restricts Booking-Platform Access for Unauthorized Third-Party AI Agents
United Airlines restricts booking-platform access for unauthorized third-party AI agents and will update its carriage terms.

4. Magnifica Air orders 10 Airbus A220-300 ACJ aircraft
Magnifica Air orders 10 A220 ACJ jets, expanding its future fleet to 17 aircraft.

facts.claim: On November 11, 2026, First Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Industry and Trade Karel Havlíček told reporters in Kyiv that Czechia could supply Ukraine with up to 16 Aero Vodochody L-39 Skyfox jets.
facts.sourceQuote: Czechia could supply Ukraine with up to 16 Aero Vodochody L-39 Skyfox jets, First Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Industry and Trade Karel Havlíček told reporters in Kyiv on November 11, 2026.

facts.claim: Havlíček said four aircraft had previously been confirmed.
facts.sourceQuote: Havlíček, who was leading a Czech business mission to Ukraine, said four aircraft had previously been confirmed

facts.claim: Havlíček said he had discussed the supply of another 12 with Ukrainian Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi.
facts.sourceQuote: Havlíček, who was leading a Czech business mission to Ukraine, said four aircraft had previously been confirmed and that he had discussed the supply of another 12 with Ukrainian Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi.

facts.claim: The talks produced a preliminary confirmation that the additional aircraft could be supplied, according to the Czech News Agency (ČTK).
facts.sourceQuote: The talks had produced a “preliminary confirmation” that the additional aircraft could be supplied, according to the Czech News Agency (ČTK)

facts.claim: Aero currently produces approximately 12 Skyfox jets per year.
facts.sourceQuote: Aero currently produces approximately 12 Skyfox jets per year.

facts.claim: No delivery schedule has been announced.
facts.sourceQuote: No delivery schedule has been announced.

facts.claim: Emirates will take ownership of six Airbus A380-800 aircraft that it currently operates as part of its fleet under a lease agreement with Qatar’s Lesha Bank.
facts.sourceQuote: Emirates will take ownership of six Airbus A380-800 aircraft currently operated as part of its fleet under a lease agreement with Qatar’s Lesha Bank.

facts.claim: On November 10, 2026, Lesha Bank confirmed an agreement to sell six Airbus A380s to Emirates.
facts.sourceQuote: On November 10, 2026, Lesha Bank confirmed it had reached an agreement to sell six Airbus A380s to Emirates

facts.claim: Two of the six aircraft sales had already been completed.
facts.sourceQuote: On November 10, 2026, Lesha Bank confirmed it had reached an agreement to sell six Airbus A380s to Emirates , two of which have already been completed.

facts.claim: The sale of the remaining four A380s is due to be concluded in stages through April 2028 as their respective leases conclude.
facts.sourceQuote: Sale of the remaining four A380s are due to be concluded in stages through April 2028, as their respective leases conclude.

facts.claim: The six A380s were leased to Emirates through Amedeo Air Four Plus.
facts.sourceQuote: The six A380s were leased to Emirates through Amedeo Air Four Plus which was acquired by Lesha Bank in June 2026.

facts.claim: Lesha Bank acquired Amedeo Air Four Plus in June 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: The six A380s were leased to Emirates through Amedeo Air Four Plus which was acquired by Lesha Bank in June 2026.

facts.claim: United Airlines announced on November 11, 2026, that it is restricting unauthorized third-party artificial intelligence (AI) agents from accessing its digital booking platform.
facts.sourceQuote: United Airlines announced on November 11, 2026, that it is restricting unauthorized third-party artificial intelligence (AI) agents from accessing its digital booking platform.

facts.claim: The airline said AI agents could expose sensitive passenger information.
facts.sourceQuote: The airline said that AI agents pose an unacceptable risk because they could expose sensitive passenger information

facts.claim: The airline said actions by AI agents could result in unintended purchases or unwanted changes to customer accounts, including its MileagePlus loyalty program.
facts.sourceQuote: The airline said that AI agents pose an unacceptable risk because they could expose sensitive passenger information and take actions which could result in unintended purchases or unwanted changes to customer accounts, including the airline’s MileagePlus loyalty program.

facts.claim: United Airlines expressed concern about a potential violation of Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and Department of Transportation (DOT) security regulations.
facts.sourceQuote: In a statement United Airlines went even further, expressing concern about the potential violation of Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and Department of Transportation (DOT) security regulations.

facts.claim: The restriction also extends to third-party AI agents used through indirect channels such as online travel agents and aggregators.
facts.sourceQuote: The ban on third- party AI agents also extends to their use through indirect channels such as online travel agents (OTAs) and aggregators.

facts.claim: United Airlines said it will update its conditions of carriage to reflect the decision.
facts.sourceQuote: United Airlines said it will be updating its conditions of carriage to reflect this decision.

facts.claim: Magnifica Air disclosed an order for 10 Airbus A220-300 ACJ aircraft.
facts.sourceQuote: Magnifica Air, a Florida-based startup airline which plans to offer premium-only scheduled flights from 2027, has disclosed an order for 10 Airbus A220-300 ACJ aircraft

facts.claim: The firm order takes Magnifica Air’s future fleet to 17 aircraft.
facts.sourceQuote: This firm order takes Magnifica Air’s future fleet to 17 aircraft

facts.claim: Magnifica intends to use the jets for scheduled premium services combining low-density cabins with elements of private aviation, including dedicated terminals, ground transfers and concierge assistance.
facts.sourceQuote: Magnifica intends to use the jets for scheduled premium services combining low-density cabins with elements of private aviation, including dedicated terminals, ground transfers and concierge assistance.

facts.claim: Magnifica Air selected Airbus’ Skywise as its digital data platform of choice to power functions such as flight planning.
facts.sourceQuote: Magnifica Air also confirmed that it has selected Airbus’ Skywise as its digital data platform of choice to power functions such as flight planning

facts.claim: Airbus and Magnifica have not announced a delivery timetable for the 10 aircraft or when they are expected to enter service.
facts.sourceQuote: Airbus and Magnifica have not announced a delivery timetable for the 10 aircraft, or when they are expected to enter service.
